connector.name: Vulnicheck
connector.registryDescription: HTTP MCP Server for comprehensive Python vulnerability scanning and security analysis.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image vulnicheck:main. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the andrasfe account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: NVD_API_KEY
env.description: API key for NIST National Vulnerability Database (increases rate limit from 5 to 50 requests per 30 seconds)

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub token for Advisory Database access (increases rate limit to 5000 requests per hour)

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key for LLM-based risk assessment in MCP passthrough operations

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Anthropic API key for LLM-based risk assessment (alternative to OpenAI)

env.name: CACHE_TTL
env.description: Cache time-to-live in seconds for vulnerability data (default: 900)

env.name: VULNICHECK_HTTP_ONLY
env.description: Enable HTTP-only mode with MCP client delegation (true/false, default: auto-detect)
